dungeon.title: Adventure Cave: Lantern Trial
dungeon.subtitle: Seven rooms · Three lantern shards · One gatekeeper
dungeon.controls: WASD / arrows to move · X attack · C dash · Space interact
dungeon.locked: The east door is still sealed by this room's trial.
dungeon.victoryCopy: The gatekeeper sheathed his blade. You leave the cave with all three shards.
dungeon.openChest: Approach the chest and press Space
dungeon.bossShield: The gatekeeper is shielded: defeat the reinforcements
dungeon.bossShieldBroken: The shield breaks. The gatekeeper is exposed again.
dungeon.restored: The wayfarer lantern restored some health.
dungeon.trainingSecond: Training wave two: bats flank while spiders endure.
dungeon.echoAgain: The echo changes the sequence. A new round begins.
dungeon.tideReverse: The tide reverses and a new plate order lights up.
dungeon.watcherArrives: The skeleton watcher enters with its first escort.
dungeon.watcherLastStand: The vault's final watch is closing in.
dungeon.room0Hint: Read the sign with Space and finish two sustained training rounds; bats and tougher spiders join the second.
dungeon.room1Hint: Solve three increasingly long lantern sequences; every answer opens a sustained echo ambush.
dungeon.room2Hint: Choose the upper Path of Observation or lower Path of Courage, then survive its three encounter stages.
dungeon.room3Hint: Complete two four-plate circuits while fighting between horizontal and vertical tide blades.
dungeon.room4Hint: Endure three vault watches, then approach the opened chest to recover the second shard.
dungeon.room5Hint: Defend the central lantern through three waves. The final checkpoint follows.
dungeon.room6Hint: Defeat the three-phase gatekeeper; clear sustained reinforcements during both shield intervals.
dungeon.sequence: Tablet: Sun lights night; night sinks into moss.
dungeon.bossNeeds: The gatekeeper answers only three complete lantern shards.

page.copy.if-you-are-also-exploring-comp: If you are also exploring complex systems, AI, or new ways of collaborating, you can reach me through my public profiles.
page.copy.a-clear-topic-context-and-ques: A clear topic, context, and question help a conversation reach the useful part faster.
page.copy.different-platforms-carry-diff: Different platforms carry different kinds of notes. Choose a route and it will depart in a new tab.
page.copy.young-e-software-engineering-b: Young E. · Software engineering background · Engineer and builder.
page.copy.artificial-intelligence-open-s: Artificial intelligence, open systems, on-chain markets, and methods for turning complex problems into reliable software.
page.copy.visit-github-for-public-code-a: Visit GitHub for public code and projects; the social page links to further writing.
page.copy.this-public-version-records-th: This public version records the durable through-line without inventing companies, roles, or dates that have not been supplied.
page.copy.for-a-new-problem-identify-con: For a new problem, identify constraints, state, and feedback loops before choosing system boundaries.
page.copy.i-value-verifiable-work-runnab: I value verifiable work: runnable prototypes, clear interfaces, reproducible builds, and honest failure states.
page.copy.the-first-field-note-is-the-to: The first field note is the town itself.
page.copy.turning-a-homepage-into-a-plac: Turning a homepage into a place
page.copy.information-architecture-does-: Information architecture does not have to be a navbar. The dock holds outbound links, the library holds long-form material, the beach holds interests, and the cave holds an independent game. Spatial relationships make links memorable.
page.copy.github-pages-has-no-backend-bu: GitHub Pages has no backend, but the browser can still remember position, music preferences, and dungeon progress. The key is separating portable local state from published content.
page.copy.these-pages-record-technical-f: These pages record technical facts confirmed while building this static RPG homepage.
page.copy.the-main-world-runs-client-and: The main world runs client and authoritative game logic in the same browser process, so no persistent server is required. Tiled maps still preserve clean map, event, and collision layers.
page.copy.every-content-page-and-game-ha: Every content page and game has a directly addressable directory path. The build emits real index.html files instead of relying on server fallback rules.
page.copy.this-shell-will-grow-with-real: This shell will grow with real notes. For now it states its place and purpose within the town.
page.copy.wayfarer-lantern-town-uses-a-s: All pixel art, UI, sound effects, and pack music come from Ninja Adventure; two site-owner tracks are registered separately for the town radio.
page.copy.created-by-pixel-boy-and-aaa-l: Created by Pixel-Boy and AAA. Licensed under CC0 1.0 Universal. Assets are cropped, scaled, and composed for the main world, page components, and independent dungeon.
page.copy.created-by-keijiro: Thanks to Keijiro for creating Jacquard, an experimental Unity music tool that offers a clear, exploratory starting point for sound and interactive making.
page.copy.i-focus-on-ai-open-systems-and: I focus on AI, open systems, and on-chain markets. I like compressing complex problems into clear models, then turning those models into reliable tools.
page.copy.keeping-a-short-path-between-i: Keeping a short path between ideas and implementation means exposing abstract judgment to real feedback early: write it, build it, run it, and keep refining.
page.copy.a-conventional-homepage-compre: A conventional homepage compresses a person into a bio and links. This town keeps a sense of place: knowledge lives in the library, interests wash up on the beach, and external journeys depart from the dock.

page.interest.gamesIntro: I like games whose rules become intuitive quickly while leaving depth for practiced players.

page.interest.musicIntro: Music here is not an autoplaying backdrop; it is a broadcast station controlled by the visitor.
page.interest.lifeIntro: A place for ordinary moments that do not need to be explained by projects, résumés, or metrics.
